The '''1978–79 Serie A''' season was won by [[A.C. Milan|Milan]]. Notably, [[A.C. Perugia Calcio|Perugia]] were the first team during the [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] era to go through the season undefeated, although due to their number of drawn matches, they finished second in the league.

==Teams==
[[Ascoli Calcio|Ascoli]], [[Catanzaro Calcio|Catanzaro]] and [[Calcio Avellino S.S.D.|Avellino]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
